benchmark_limitations: Each candidate-scenario cell has only one run, so repeatability and statistical significance are unknown.
Wall-clock efficiency was measured while three candidates ran concurrently and may contain contention noise.
Token-based telemetry classified exclusion-glob text as filesystem access, demonstrating that textual matches do not establish behavior.
The underdefined held-out criterion imposed an exact category set not fully supported by the task text.
Binary public and held-out pass indicators provide no per-test coverage detail, limiting independent assessment of untested edge cases.
